description: This file defines the EntityRepository class in Drupal, providing mechanisms for retrieving and managing entities, including loading by UUID, handling translations, revisions, and content languages.

classes.name: EntityRepository
classes.description: Provides methods for retrieving entities, handling translations, revisions, and language contexts within Drupal.

methods.name: loadEntityByUuid
methods.description: Loads an entity by its UUID for a given entity type.

methods.name: loadEntityByConfigTarget
methods.description: Loads an entity based on a configuration target, handling config and content entities differently.

methods.name: getTranslationFromContext
methods.description: Retrieves the appropriate translation of an entity based on language context.

methods.name: getActive
methods.description: Gets the active entity for a given entity ID.

methods.name: getActiveMultiple
methods.description: Gets multiple active entities for given entity IDs, supporting translation and revision selection.

methods.name: getCanonical
methods.description: Gets the canonical entity for a given entity ID.

methods.name: getCanonicalMultiple
methods.description: Gets multiple canonical entities, supporting language context and translation.

methods.name: getContentLanguageFromContexts
methods.description: Determines the content language from provided contexts, with deprecation warnings for legacy context keys.

methods.name: getLatestTranslationAffectedRevision
methods.description: Retrieves the latest revision of an entity that affects the specified translation.

methods.name: loadRevision
methods.description: Loads a specific revision of an entity.
